layouts.name: Idiada Dry Handling Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The two complete dry-handling lobes and unbroken connecting curves match the catalogue configuration. Optional small chicanes in both lobes and the longer eastern variant are excluded. Independent source distance is 2178.1 m versus the catalogue distance of 2182 m. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 2178.1 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
